title: Palindromic Substrings
description:
Given a string `s`, return the total number of palindromic substrings in `s`.

A string is a palindrome when it reads the same backward as forward. A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within the string. Substrings with different start or end indices are counted as distinct palindromic substrings even if they consist of the same characters.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters ('a'-'z').
hints: Every palindrome expands symmetrically around either a single center character (odd length) or a gap between two adjacent characters (even length), giving 2n - 1 possible centers.
Expanding outward from every center counts all palindromic substrings in O(n^2) time and O(1) space.
For O(n) time, insert '#' sentinels between characters and run Manacher's algorithm: each transformed center i with radius p[i] contributes (p[i] + 1) // 2 palindromes.
